capabilities: copy the raw Markdown of the active note to the clipboard
copy multiple selected notes or a folder from the file explorer
toggle including or stripping YAML frontmatter
add a copy command to the mobile toolbar or desktop ribbon
disambiguation: Copies raw Markdown text to the clipboard; it does not export files to disk or convert formats.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README says Community Plugins installation works 'once published'.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to copy a note's full raw Markdown to the clipboard, especially from the mobile toolbar.
summary: Clipboard utility that copies the full raw Markdown of the active note, multiple selected notes, or a folder to the clipboard on desktop and mobile.
